categories.main_business_segments: Korea Steel Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the steel manufacturing sector, focusing on the production and sale of various steel products including billets, shaped steel, and round bars. These products serve as fundamental materials for industries such as construction, shipbuilding, automotive, and machinery. The company also engages in export and domestic sales of these steel products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses electric furnace steelmaking with steel scrap as the main raw material, followed by heating, rolling, and cooling processes to produce billets and various shaped steel products. It emphasizes modernized production facilities, including a newly completed rolling mill plant started in 2022, and employs a multi-product specialization strategy to flexibly respond to market fluctuations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction companies, shipbuilders, automotive manufacturers, and machinery producers. Major clients listed are GS Construction, Heungseong Steel, Ssangyong Steel, POSCO E&C, and HD Hyundai Heavy Industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of sales in the domestic market and some exports.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with production facilities located in Gyeongsangnam-do (Haman, Sasang, and Noksan). It also engages in export activities, indicating some international market presence, though the primary focus remains on the domestic Korean market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Korea Steel operates primarily in the midstream segment of the steel supply chain, converting raw materials such as steel scrap into semi-finished products like billets and finished steel products for downstream industries. It sources raw materials from recycling companies and supplies steel products to various manufacturing sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous modernization of production facilities, new product development, quality and cost competitiveness, and creating new demand. It pursues a multi-product specialization strategy to adapt to industry cyclicality. Recently, it has added small modular reactor (SMR) based electricity production and sales as a new business purpose to diversify and expand its business portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of steel products including shaped steel, round bars, and billets. Sales are conducted via order-based and market sales channels domestically and through export contracts internationally. The company does not report subscription or licensing revenues but relies on product sales and related services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Korea Steel operates in a highly competitive steel industry characterized by price and quality competition, stable raw material procurement, and production efficiency. The company positions itself through quality differentiation, broad product range, timely delivery, and customer satisfaction, leveraging modernized facilities and flexible production.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported total sales of approximately 830 billion KRW, with operating profit of 47.3 billion KRW and net profit of 28.1 billion KRW. Total assets stood at about 561 billion KRW with equity of 226 billion KRW. The company has shown revenue growth and improved operating profit compared to the previous year, supported by stable production from new facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Korea Steel emphasizes high-quality steel products with a wide variety of small and medium-sized steel types, ensuring optimal delivery times and customer satisfaction. Its value proposition includes modernized production technology, cost competitiveness, and the ability to flexibly respond to market demand fluctuations through a multi-product specialization strategy.
